recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black and white portrait of a woman in a denim jacket and dark sunglasses, set against a textured wall, featuring bold vertical magenta typography and geometric color blocks in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds while oversized vertical text anchors the right edge.
Grainy monochrome photography contrasts with flat, vibrant vector graphic elements.
The diagonal line of the denim jacket shoulder leads the eye toward the vertical text block.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography with visible film grain.
A single primary accent color (magenta) for the largest text element.
Vertical orientation for the primary display text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, slightly off-center to the left, filling the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's dark sunglasses and wind-swept hair create the central focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the denim jacket, then travels vertically up the right-side text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured wall behind the subject provides a neutral, gritty background for text overlay.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: High-contrast black and white (subject and background).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and cyan (geometric blocks at the top).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast in the photo; maximum saturation in the graphic overlays.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stacking of characters rotated 90 degrees clockwise
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a clean geometric sans with a heavy, blocky slab-serif.
graphicDevices: Cyan diagonal geometric shape at top edge

preserve: Vertical orientation of the large text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric sans-serif display style.
Matches the heavy slab-serif subtitle style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-contrast, grainy black and white photograph of a woman with dark hair blowing across her face, wearing dark sunglasses and a textured denim jacket, leaning against a rough stucco wall. Leave the right third of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large vertical magenta text in a geometric sans-serif along the right edge. In the top right corner, add a small yellow rectangle containing black slab-serif text, with a cyan triangle peaking from the top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the photo grainy and high-contrast black and white?
Is the largest text magenta and oriented vertically?
Is there a yellow block with black text in the top right?
Is the denim texture clearly visible?

adjustableVariables: Specific hue of the magenta accent
Tightness of the vertical text tracking
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced tension between photo and graphic elements
Clean, sharp vector edges for text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the vertical text is rotated 90 degrees correctly.
Check that the magenta color is vibrant and not muted.
Confirm the denim jacket has a distinct tactile texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Grainy B&W Portrait] + [Vertical Geometric Sans-Serif in Magenta] + [Top-Right Corner Color Block Accents].
